notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it, Sapling Nursery, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sapling Nursery trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Sapling Nursery trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
